description: Make one finished video again in another language, into a new video beside it, as the app's Another language does: a UGC video with its own script and presenter, a product video with its voiceover said again over the same picture. This spends the team's credits: the price get_video or get_product_video lists in after_steps as another_language, or its voiced price for a voiced language, refunded if it fails. Only in a language that after_steps lists for it. Answers an id at once: call get_video with it, or get_product_video for a product video's, about once a minute until its status is ready or failed.

credits.description: The credits after_steps lists for this language, its voiced price for a voiced language; a different figure is refused.

id.description: The id of a finished video, from make_video, list_videos or make_product_video.

idempotency_key.description: Any string unique to this video. Calling again with the same key and the same arguments answers as the first call did and spends nothing more.

language.description: The language to make it in, one after_steps lists.

part.description: Which of its videos, as get_video names it: v1, the default, v2 and on.

name: another_language
title: Another language
